<thought>The most intense peak is at m/z 180.0423. In ESI positive mode this likely corresponds to the molecular ion (M⁺·) rather than an adduct, because the formula C₉H₈O₄ matches this exact mass (108 + 8·1.007825 + 4·15.994915 = 180.0423 Da) and gives an integer double‑bond equivalent (DBE = 6). Therefore the molecular formula of the sample is C9H8O4.</thought>
<final_answer>C9H8O4</final_answer>
